Action: Implemented locked SafetyDriverProfile in cert-llvm (WP-2), ISO 26262/DO-330 fault-injection qualification in cert-qual-suite (E-19), and freestanding C17 Stage-1 Clang conformance suite in runtime/tests/stage1_conformance.c + quality-gate.yml

Action: Enforced -fno-finite-loops in SafetyDriverProfile, implemented 3-step inductive loop cut-point Z3 synthesis with Tau^omega continuation preservation in loop_cert.rs (E-20), and proved check_loop_cutpoint_cfg_open_sound + K<=16 unrolling in validator/CertValidator.v

Action: Stripped unverified alias metadata (WP-1), enforced constrained llc/lld (--no-relax --icf=none) + static_stack_bytes (WP-2), guarded loop-inlining in Inline.v (WP-3), built freestanding MISRA/CERT C mem*/i128 builtins in runtime/, and implemented ELF64 AArch64/RISC-V MC & relocation checker cert-backend-check (Phase 4.2, E-18)
